queries.sql:
SELECT module_id AS dimension,
             COUNT(*) AS total,
             SUM(CASE WHEN user_action = 'ACCEPTED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS accepted,
             SUM(CASE WHEN user_action = 'REJECTED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rejected,
             SUM(CASE WHEN user_action = 'PENDING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pending,
             AVG(confidence_score) AS avg_confidence
      FROM SNOWCONSO_RVG_DE.PUBLIC.FACT_AI_AUDIT
      GROUP BY module_id
      ORDER BY module_id
